_note: USD per million tokens. Operator-maintained: these rates are NOT fetched from any provider and must be checked against the provider's current price list before a cost figure is quoted anywhere. A model with a null entry is dispatchable but its runs are recorded as unpriced (cost null), never as $0 and never at a guessed rate. tests/test_prices.py enforces that every dispatchable model has an entry, not that the numbers are right.

_schema.cache_read: USD per 1M cached input tokens read
_schema.cache_write: USD per 1M input tokens written to cache
